# pip-requirements-mixed

Hand-written requirements files in a requirements/ directory: an index URL with credentials (which
must not reach the output), includes, environment markers, extras, `===`, a pin with spaces around
the operator and hashes on continuation lines, unpinned ranges and a wildcard, a name in odd case
and separators (normalised as PEP 503 does), a direct Git reference, an editable Git checkout, an
editable local path, and a direct wheel URL with a hash fragment.
